purpose: Durable cover-production authority for Azure Reach. Cover recipes live in data/shows/azure-reach-s1/covers.json; this file governs scoped pixel-reference use for masthead and trade-dress continuity.

authority.issueSpecificRecipe: The assembled selected AZR_S1E##_COVER recipe controls the issue-specific selling image, cast, composition, spoiler ceiling, thumbnail read, palette emphasis and exact cover lettering.
authority.tradeDressReference: The released StarSplitterVisions Azure Reach Issue 1 cover controls masthead and trade-dress pixels for Issues 2-6.
authority.characterIdentity: Released StarSplitterVisions story art plus assembler-visible Azure Reach characters.json visual anchors control recurring character identity; clearly approved current-production artwork may extend post-release state.
rules: Issue 1 is already released canon and is the trade-dress anchor; do not regenerate or replace it unless the user explicitly reopens the released cover.
Before generating any Issue 2-6 cover, retrieve and visually inspect the actual Issue 1 cover pixels. A path, SHA, description, memory or metadata record is not a substitute for pixel readback.

Use the Issue 1 cover reference only for masthead/trade dress: logo proportions, placement, issue-number treatment, title hierarchy, edge clearances, cyan/white/deep-navy brand rhythm and premium finish.
Do not use the Issue 1 cover as composition authority for later covers.
Do not carry Issue 1 promotional blurbs into later covers unless an issue recipe explicitly supplies them.
Each later cover must remain compositionally distinct and follow its own assembled recipe.
Character identity references do not control cover layout or promotional typography.
No generated cover becomes durable production authority until it passes thumbnail/readability, recipe fidelity, visual continuity, lettering and explicit user approval.

references.use: Mandatory pixel-read trade-dress reference for Azure Reach Issues 2-6.

coverRecipeSource.rule: Use the exact assembled selected cover recipe. Raw metadata not emitted by the assembler is not generation instruction.

generationOrder: AZR_S1E01_COVER is released canon and serves as the trade-dress anchor; no regeneration required.
AZR_S1E02_COVER through AZR_S1E06_COVER each require actual pixel readback of the released Issue 1 cover for trade dress only.
For each selected cover, resolve issue-specific character/world references separately from the trade-dress reference.
completionGate: Correct recurring character and location references.
For Issues 2-6, actual released Issue 1 cover pixels inspected in active multimodal context.
One-second dominant hook reads at thumbnail size.
Masthead and issue-number treatment are exact, legible and consistent with released Issue 1.
No spoiler beyond the selected recipe's spoiler ceiling.
Animals remain safe, natural and not the joke.
No invented promotional, environmental or social-media text.
No generic cast lineup or recap collage unless explicitly required by the selected recipe.
User approval before any generated cover is promoted to durable production authority.
